title: Epic RPG: Salvage Inventory
description: An inventory system to quickly remove items from your inventory, similar to some RPGs.
body:
Salvage Inventory

Salvage Inventory is a simple utility mod designed to make inventory cleanup faster and more convenient. It adds an extra inventory dedicated to removing unwanted items without having to throw them on the ground or manually clear space one slot at a time.

When you open the player inventory, you can access the Salvage Inventory screen using a configurable keybind from the controls menu. By default, this key is Q, but it can be changed to any other key in the settings.

Inside this interface, you will find a 27-slot upper storage area where you can place any items you want to destroy. Once the items are there, pressing the delete button instantly removes everything stored in that section.

The mod is designed to stay simple and predictable: items placed in the upper section are not deleted automatically, and they are only destroyed when the button is pressed. This gives the player a chance to review the contents before removing them and helps prevent unnecessary mistakes. If the salvage inventory is empty, the delete sound will not play.
